title: Threshold
description: A directional boundary used to classify or trigger an evaluation (CR-MET-006). 4 directional models (higher_is_better, lower_is_better, bounded_optimum, exact_match) and 4 levels (critical, warning, acceptable, optimal) per user-supplied section 6.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

threshold_metric_ref.description: The PerformanceMetric id being constrained (relationship dea:constrains, extended in CR-MET-006).

threshold_value.description: The boundary value(s). A number for single-direction thresholds (higher_is_better, lower_is_better, exact_match); an object {min, max} for bounded_optimum.

threshold_level.description: CR-MET-006 binding (Threshold.level controlled vocabulary; 4 values). A Metric MAY have multiple Thresholds (one per level).

escalation_rule_ref.description: Reference to an escalation rule (e.g. notification policy, runbook).
